title: Submit a complete interview experience
preconditions: The local app is running against the isolated database.
An approved institutional session is available.
The run may create one synthetic record and remove it afterwards.

steps.action: Open /contribute and submit with required fields blank.
steps.expected: Submission is blocked and the first missing required field is identified.

steps.action: Fill company, role, candidate details, one round with a walkthrough and one question, then submit.
steps.expected: The record is created, the form reports success, and the new record is reachable.

steps.action: Open /my-experiences and confirm the new record is listed.
steps.expected: The record appears under the signed-in user's contributions.

cleanup: Delete the synthetic record created by this check and confirm it is gone from the directory.
risk: Writes to the isolated database only. Blocked without an institutional identity.
